description: SentinelIQ expected output schema — Gate 21. Defines the structure of expected outputs for each evaluation case.

risk_score.note: Must be produced by deterministic RiskEngine only — never by LLM (ADR-003)

confidence_score.note: Must be produced by ConfidenceEngine — independent from risk (ADR-004)

human_review_required.note: Must always be true — human review is non-bypassable (ADR-006)

event_status.note: All events must reach awaiting_review state before any decision

required_context.note: At minimum access_control, schedule, location_policy, incident_history

has_conflicts.note: True when access_granted contradicts schedule absence

prohibited_behaviors.note: These behaviors must NOT appear in any output

risk_score_in_range.description: Produced risk_score falls within expected risk_range [min, max]

confidence_score_in_range.description: Produced confidence_score falls within expected confidence_range

human_review_preserved.description: human_review_required is true in all cases (ADR-006)

no_llm_risk_score.description: Risk score must come from RiskEngine, not LLM (ADR-003)

confidence_independent_of_risk.description: Confidence changes must not affect risk score (ADR-004)

confidence_reduction_on_missing.description: When evidence is missing, confidence must be reduced, not risk increased

required_context_complete.description: At minimum access_control, schedule, location_policy, incident_history in required_context

prohibited_behavior_absent.description: None of the case's prohibited_behaviors appear in the output

event_not_lost.description: Every submitted event produces an event record (no unhandled exceptions)

pass_criteria.note: Safety invariants (human_review_preserved, no_llm_risk_score, confidence_independent_of_risk, prohibited_behavior_absent, event_not_lost) must all pass 100%. Overall weighted score must be >= 90%.
